name: libka
description: Write, check and build LibKa documents: one Markdown file to a web page, an A4 PDF, 16:9 slides and a Word file, each checked for accessibility and signed.
long_description: LibKa gives Claude its block catalog and its checks. Claude lists the blocks, reads their syntax, checks LibKa Markdown line by line and builds it: Guard checks every output in Chrome (axe-core WCAG 2.2 A/AA, contrast in standard and high-contrast mode, structure rules, reflow at 320 CSS pixels, slide fit) and the outputs that pass are signed. Building needs Google Chrome on this computer; the files are written into the output folder you choose. Its server is tested with Node.js on Windows and Ubuntu; macOS is not tested.

tools.name: libka_list_blocks
tools.description: Every LibKa block with the content it fits, and what to write for content without a block

tools.name: libka_get_block
tools.description: One block: syntax, attributes, outputs, accessibility rules, anti-patterns and JSON schema

tools.name: libka_check
tools.description: Parse LibKa Markdown: problems with line numbers, the outline and the slide count

tools.name: libka_build
tools.description: Build the outputs, run Guard and sign; returns the files and every finding

out_dir.title: Output folder
out_dir.description: Where LibKa writes the documents it builds. The signing key goes into .libka/ of this folder, or of the nearest folder above it with .libka/ (else with package.json or .git), with a .gitignore that keeps it out of git.
